Container.Name: qbittorrentvpn
Container.Overview: qBittorrent built from source, behind an OpenVPN or WireGuard tunnel with a fail-closed firewall: nothing reaches the internet outside the tunnel, DNS included, and traffic stays blocked while the tunnel is down. [br][br]Put your provider's .ovpn file in the openvpn folder of the appdata path, or its WireGuard .conf file in the wireguard folder, set LAN_NETWORK to your LAN, and start the container. For OpenVPN, set VPN_USERNAME and VPN_PASSWORD too. [br][br]The Extra Parameters this template sets give the container what it needs: --cap-add=NET_ADMIN --device=/dev/net/tun --stop-timeout=150. It does not need Privileged. [br][br]Setup, settings and troubleshooting: https://markusmcnugen.github.io/docker-qBittorrentvpn/

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: qBittorrent's WebUI. To use another container port, set WEBUI_PORT to the same number.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where qBittorrent saves downloads, with incomplete files in temp.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: The VPN configuration, in the openvpn or wireguard folder, and qBittorrent's profile.

Config.Name: LAN_NETWORK
Config.Description: Your LAN, in CIDR form, comma-separated for several. Only these networks may reach the WebUI.

Config.Name: VPN_USERNAME
Config.Description: OpenVPN username from your provider. Leave empty for WireGuard.

Config.Name: VPN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: OpenVPN password from your provider. Leave empty for WireGuard.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User qBittorrent runs as; 99 is Unraid's nobody.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group qBittorrent runs as; 100 is Unraid's users.

Config.Name: WEBUI_USERNAME
Config.Description: WebUI login, applied on every start. Empty keeps qBittorrent's own.

Config.Name: WEBUI_PASSWORD
Config.Description: WebUI password, applied on every start. Empty keeps qBittorrent's own; without one, qBittorrent prints a temporary password in the log.

Config.Name: VPN_ENABLED
Config.Description: no runs qBittorrent with no VPN and no firewall.

Config.Name: VPN_TYPE
Config.Description: auto, openvpn or wireguard. auto uses whichever folder holds a configuration.

Config.Name: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING
Config.Description: off, auto, natpmp, protonvpn or pia: how the container asks the provider for a forwarded port.

Config.Name: NAME_SERVERS
Config.Description: DNS servers, comma-separated, used before the VPN's. Empty uses the VPN's own.

Config.Name: WEBUI_PORT
Config.Description: qBittorrent's WebUI port inside the container; change the WebUI port mapping's container port to match.

Config.Name: PRIVOXY_ENABLED
Config.Description: yes starts Privoxy, an HTTP proxy whose traffic stays in the tunnel, on the Privoxy port.
